decisions: Date rows written 'U.C. 00YY.MM'; full-width English subtitles converted to ASCII with the game's wording.
Where English word order forces it, content shifts by a phrase between rows within the same sentence (S02095-97, S02113-16, S02139-42); no rows merged or split.
Narration tense follows the JP: present for most intros, past where the JP uses past (S02083-84, S02113-21, S02134-36).
Several narration rows exceed the ~2.4x JP width guide (max_bytes is null); full wording kept for the orchestrator to measure.
